# Shibumi Shell 0.1.1-beta.9

This prerelease restores host-owned Omarchy Notifications compatibility and
adds an explicit Recent/Live notification presentation without introducing a
second notification owner.

## Notifications

- Normalize Omarchy's current `popupModel` and supported legacy notification
  models through one private adapter.
- Add explicit `Recent` and `Live` tabs, with Recent on the left and Live on the
  right.
- Use `color04` for Recent and `color03` for Live.
- Preserve Clear all and per-notification dismiss actions on both tabs.
- Handle DND, history replay, stale replay results, host replacement, and host
  unavailability.
- Confirm real Vesktop notification payloads through Omarchy's authoritative
  host history.

## Ownership and validation

Omarchy remains the sole Notifications owner. Shibumi exposes primitive rows and
typed actions only; it does not create a replacement NotificationServer or read
private Omarchy history files.

The candidate retains the 24-plugin, one-production-Quickshell architecture.
Focused adapter and production-boundary tests pass. The pinned Omarchy baseline
content drift and physical multi-output, mixed-scale, hardware, final Machine 2
UI, and full visual-freeze gates remain explicitly recorded release limits.

Full changelog: [v0.1.1-beta.8...v0.1.1-beta.9](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.1.1-beta.8...v0.1.1-beta.9)
